summary: Wabash Valley Power Association asks FERC to issue an errata to the E-7 show cause order removing it from the caption and listing it with the non-jurisdictional transmission owners, since it ceased to be a public utility on January 1, 2025.
ask: Issue an errata removing Wabash Valley from the caption of EL26-67-000 and adding it to the list of non-jurisdictional PJM transmission owners in footnote 13.

points.point: Wabash says it ceased to be a public utility on January 1, 2025 because it is wholly owned by exempt cooperatives.
points.quote: it ceased to be a public utility on January 1, 2025 because it became exempt from the Federal Power Act as a result of being wholly owned by exempt entities.

points.point: Wabash says it is similarly situated to the non-jurisdictional owners FERC listed in footnote 13.
points.quote: it is a PTO that is similarly situated to all of the other non-jurisdictional entities listed in footnote 13 of the Order.

points.point: Wabash does not dispute the need to address large-load and co-located load service in organized markets.
points.quote: it does not dispute the need for the Commission to address issues surrounding service to large load and co-located load within organized markets and elsewhere.

points.point: The requested errata would remove Wabash from the caption and add it to footnote 13.
points.quote: removes WVPA from the caption of Docket No. EL26-67-000, which intended to identify only PJM and jurisdictional PTOs

throughLine.text: Seeks correction of the E-7 show cause order's list of respondents; FERC granted the change in its August 13, 2026 errata notice.
